name: Banana Bread
description: Not too sweet. Great for when you have friends over for tea.

ingredients.name: Mashed bananas
ingredients.originalText: 1 1/2 cups mashed bananas (this is around 4-5 bananas)

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.originalText: 1 cup sugar (brown or white is fine)

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 2 cups all purpose flour; 1 1/2 teaspoon baking powder; 1/2 teaspoon baking soda; 1 teaspoon cinnamon; 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg; 1/4 teaspoon ginger; 1/4 teaspoon salt; 1 1/2 cups mashed bananas (this is around 4-5 bananas); 2 eggs; 1 cup sugar (brown or white is fine); 1/2 cup butter; 1/4 cup crushed walnuts. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Set out the bowls, pans, measuring tools, and any baking equipment named in the steps below. Wash any fresh produce before use. Keep raw eggs, meat, and their utensils separate from ready-to-eat food.
Mix the wet ingredients (eggs, bananas, butter, sugar) in one bowl.

Mix the dry ingredients (flour, baking soda/powder, spices, salt) in another
bowl.
Slowly add the wet to the dry while mixing.
Mix until dry bits of flour are gone.
Pour into lightly buttered or oiled loaf pan.

Bake for around an hour (it’s definitely ready when a wooden skewer or
chopstick poked inside comes out clean).

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Martin Chrzanowski
source.originalInstructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C)
2. Mix the wet ingredients (eggs, bananas, butter, sugar) in one bowl.
3. Mix the dry ingredients (flour, baking soda/powder, spices, salt) in another
bowl.
4. Slowly add the wet to the dry while mixing.
5. Mix until dry bits of flour are gone.
6. Pour into lightly buttered or oiled loaf pan.
7. Bake for around an hour (it’s definitely ready when a wooden skewer or
chopstick poked inside comes out clean).
